name: Auto Child Education (1.1.10)
short_description:
Stop-gap update of Auto Child Education by victoriaposting (https://steamcommunity.com/id/victoriaposting) for EU5 1.1.x compatibility.

v2.4: Updated for 1.1.10. Added option to auto-assign expensive in-depth education to heirs and crown estate children. Improved performance by short-circuiting AI countries at the on_action level.

All credit to victoriaposting for the original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3607293096
